messages:
Maya (partnerships): Quick check-in 7: AxiomAccel wants kernel-level telemetry included in the public bench. They asked for which counters we need and how we correlate them to latency. Ben/Jordan/Leo: what do you want exposed? Evan: can Axiom gate the counters behind a lab ACL?
Ben (eng-runtime): Minimum counters: time-in-kernel, GEMM cycles, memory-copy time, KV-cache-hit-rate, kernel-invocations. Tag each trace with kernel_variant and firmware_rev. We'll also want a short script to pull perf counters before/after each run. Example: `axiom-prof --snapshot run_id`
Jordan (eng-ml): From model quality side: include token-generation latency per layer if possible, and any sampling nondeterminism flags. We need deterministic seeds for quality comparisons.
Leo (eng-infra): To correlate, we need a shared run_id and timestamp alignment (NTP). Ingest format: JSONL lines with fields: run_id, ts, host_ms, chip_cycles, power_w. We'll store in s3://redwood-benching/axiom/t52/{run_id}/telemetry.jsonl. Also set alert if any run has missing telemetry segments.
Evan (AxiomAccel): We can expose counters and restrict access to Redwood lab VLAN. We'll provide axiom-prof and a /metrics endpoint. Firmware 1.2 will have counters A..F; 1.3 adds counters G,H (experimental). 1.2 is fine for the public runs. ACLs will be provided Friday.
Maya (partnerships): OK7: action items: Ben write counter list + snapshot commands, Jordan lock quality seeds, Leo configure s3/alerts, Evan send ACL and axiom-prof binary. Target: dry-run Tue.
Ben (eng-runtime): I'll post a short run snippet by EOD:
```
# snapshot counters
axiom-prof --run-id axiom-t52-1957709123 --snap pre
./run_bench --model redwood-open-7b --kernel t52-gemm --quant int8 --batch 8 --out s3://redwood-benching/axiom/t52/1957709123/
axiom-prof --run-id axiom-t52-1957709123 --snap post
```
I'll also add a `--telemetry-endpoint` flag to the runner.
Jordan (eng-ml): Seeds and eval harness shared in repo `bench/evals/axiom-t52`. Gate: if int4 quality drop >3% we'll add a note.
Leo (eng-infra): Alerts: missing telemetry -> fail run; power variance > 12% -> flag. I'll create the SQS notification and dashboard.
Evan (AxiomAccel): ACL and axiom-prof binary uploaded. PDU endpoints and credentials shared via secure channel. Lab available Tue.
QA Bot: bench-dryrun scheduled: id=axiom-t52-dry-1957709123, owner=Ben.
Maya (partnerships): Great 7: thanks everyone; I'll update partner comms and legal. Post dry-run results here.
